name: @red-cup-engineering/colony-execution-boundary-verification-service
description: Verify that a named colony's public relay Caddyfile and application unit do not run the colony's own application on the relay host.

x-agentic-metro-enterprise.admission: no writes; reads one Caddyfile and one systemd unit and reports ACCEPT or REJECT against caller-declared --expect-* values
x-agentic-metro-enterprise.refusal: VPS-origin execution of the colony's own application, and any judgment about tailnet enrollment, relay implementation, or DNS/certificate policy
